reason: E1 and E3 directly support the formation of a discontinuous Cr-rich film on 9Cr ODS and a ~40% reduction in corrosion depth for 9CrAl ODS, but neither provides evidence that the protective scale on 9CrAl ODS is a continuous Al2O3-containing film or that the mechanism involves reduced oxygen ingress and dissolution; these mechanistic premises are inferred rather than supported by the cited passages.
premises: 9Cr ODS steel forms a discontinuous, non-protective Cr-rich oxide film in liquid Pb at 600 °C
Al additions to 9Cr ODS steel promote a continuous Al2O3-containing scale
A continuous Al2O3 scale reduces oxygen ingress and metal dissolution compared to a discontinuous Cr-oxide scale
9CrAl ODS exhibits ~40% lower maximum corrosion depth than 9Cr ODS under the stated conditions
